findings.title: Seed-floor map-diameter guard uses w²+h² but the grid's widest achievable spacing is (w-1)²+(h-1)² — a never-clearable floor can still load
findings.detail: On the 40x30 map the guard rejects only seed >= 50; seed 49 loads clean (2401 < 2500) yet max cell-to-cell dist² is 39²+29²=2362, so growth_seed_sep_ok can never pass -> deterministic growth stall once estates hit cap. Edge lens adds: even sub-diameter floors (e.g. 45) can be span-unreachable (seed candidates must also sit within era span 18 of a junction) — same silent-stall class.
findings.recommended_fix: Reject when seed² > (w-1)²+(h-1)² in i64 (true widest tile spacing); optionally tighten to a span-aware or min(w,h) bound.

findings.title: new_area_seed_tiles parsed via jint: decimals silently truncate, out-of-i32-range wraps — no fail-fast, violating the jint_strict doctrine sibling keys follow
findings.detail: "new_area_seed_tiles": 10.5 truncates silently to 10; >i32::MAX wraps. Sibling tunables (cap_fraction_permille, placement.*, terminal keys) use jint_strict precisely to reject this (ODN-10 integer-only bar).
findings.recommended_fix: Parse with jint_strict; add a decimal-valued loader rejection row naming growth_groups.new_area_seed_tiles.

findings.title: New strict_spawn_class helper triggers 134 '+++ bad free' errors per odin test core run (make with context.temp_allocator + defer delete mismatch)
findings.verification: confirmed (independently reproduced by orchestrator: 136 total bad frees, 134 at growth_test.odin:528/557, 2 pre-existing in untouched health_test.odin)
findings.detail: Temp-allocator slices freed via delete — invalid free every call. Tests still exit 0 so CI stays green while tracker output is drowned, masking genuine sim-code allocation regressions. Matches a pre-existing (untouched) health_test pattern, but this PR adds 134 more.
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the two defer delete lines (temp memory is freed per test) or allocate from context.allocator so delete matches. Re-run odin test core to confirm zero growth_test bad frees.
